chunks: (Remember) David and Solomon, when they pronounced judgement about the field which was eaten up at night by sheep belonging to certain people. We were witness to their judgement.

key_terms.نَفَشَتْ: Grazed/eaten up (specifically at night or gradually)

ai.seo_question: What is the story of David and Solomon's judgment regarding the grazing sheep in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the principle of judicial discretion (ijtihad) in distributing agricultural produce, where David ruled that the owners keep their crops while Solomon advised giving the sheep the grazing rights, a decision later upheld as more equitable. The phrase 'We were witnesses to their judgment' underscores the divine oversight of their legal reasoning, affirming the infallibility of the Prophets in matters of justice. This narrative serves as a foundational model for Islamic jurisprudence regarding the fair allocation of resources between landowners and livestock herders.
